semiconductor_relevance: Medium — QEEPO specializes in electrostatic control and monitoring equipment, which is relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes but does not directly supply semiconductor components or materials.
summary: QEEPO Shanghai Static Co., Ltd. is a technology enterprise focused on the research, development, design, production, sales, and service of electrostatic control and monitoring equipment. Their products are utilized in semiconductor manufacturing to address electrostatic issues, thereby improving manufacturing processes and enhancing customer satisfaction.
capabilities: Static control solutions for manufacturing environments
